source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Control fan speed by IPMI command
1. Enter BMC Web UI.
2. Choose "Sensor detail" to check each sensor. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
3. Change "Threshold setting" if needed(follow spec theerhold value)
NOTE: The Fan Speed command might change, please refer to spec.
4. Use IPMI command to speed up to 100%: ipmitool raw 0x30 0x81 0x01 0x64
5. Use IPMI command to speed down to 0%: ipmitool raw 0x30 0x81 0x01 0x00
6. Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold.

Note: The command may vary based on OEM SPEC. (Ex. ipmitool raw 0x30 0x20)

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Sensor value should be OK in the reasonable range.
2. Sensor value is same as ipmi sdr command and web ui
3. SEL should have an event log when sensor reach to threshold.

original_test_intent: Verify fan RPM values and thresholds across BMC Web UI and IPMI, exercise approved high/low fan control so a defined threshold is reached, and confirm the correlated SEL event.
original_method: A qualified operator records each fan in BMC Web UI while approved automation captures full SDR data, optionally changes only owner-approved thresholds, applies validated 100% and 0% commands under thermal guards, checks the same sensor across views, captures SEL, and restores every setting.
manual_activity: The source requires BMC Web UI Sensor Detail observation and comparison. A qualified engineer must also authorize any threshold modification and 0% fan state; automated CLI collection cannot claim completion of the GUI acceptance view.
required_inputs: Fan-to-sensor/Web UI map and reasonable RPM ranges/tolerance
Exact threshold values, expected SEL event/severity and whether a threshold change is actually required
Current OEM 100%/0% set/readback/restore semantics and explicit zero-duty safety decision
Thermal/load/dwell limits, GUI operator, maintenance window and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not alter thresholds or run raw 0%/100% commands until platform semantics and recovery are approved.
Never leave protection thresholds or fan mode changed after the test.
Continuously monitor RPM, temperatures, alarms, load and OOB reachability; abort and restore on any limit.
Preserve complete Web UI, SDR and SEL evidence; no automatic retry or alternate OEM payload guessing.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete SDR/sensor/SEL and continuous thermal evidence for the mapped fans.
Issue only validated approved control/threshold writes and perform readback/restoration.
Compare CLI records with operator-supplied Web UI captures and report discrepancies without issuing the verdict.
engineer_actions: Observe/capture each required BMC Web UI state.
Supply/approve thresholds, fan commands, 0% exposure and safety limits.
Confirm restoration and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient. Read-only filtered output covers only part of the criteria and hides the source control, threshold, GUI and SEL-event steps.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain complete `ipmitool sdr elist` and the source OEM commands as legacy inputs, but execute writes only when the current BMC specification and linked script validate their set/readback/restore meanings. Avoid grep-only evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Web UI, SDR, optional threshold setting, 100%/0% actions, SEL threshold event and both one-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: GUARD ORIGINAL CROSS-VIEW AND THRESHOLD METHOD
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use synchronized GUI screenshots/exports and full CLI sensor data, then apply only an approved bounded threshold/control sequence while continuously recording RPM/thermal/SEL state and restoring all values.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC firmware, fan-zone mapping and hot-running safety envelope.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, CPLD, ipmitool, browser/Web UI and script versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Current owner BMC OEM sensor/control specification and source-linked script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds command provenance, continuous safety monitoring and restoration verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves GUI/IPMI equality and SEL event coverage; DeepSeek's read-only shortcut does not.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mappings, ranges, thresholds, event semantics, write commands and limits.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Artificial threshold changes may test configuration rather than natural fan behavior and must be recorded as such.

project_override_considerations: A project can omit unsafe 0% or threshold modification and approve another stimulus, but must state the resulting coverage difference. A project parameter does not remove the source-required Web UI evidence or permit claiming the original full sequence.
expected_evidence: BMC/sensor/fan map, RPM bands, thresholds, event semantics and approved control/restore plan
Timestamped BMC Web UI Sensor Detail captures and complete matching CLI sensor data
Per-state raw commands/readbacks, RPM/thermal telemetry and correlated SEL event
Restored thresholds/automatic control and final system health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The GUI/IPMI comparison, fan-control states and threshold SEL criterion form one coherent although underspecified workflow. Alternative OEM bytes are explicitly presented as platform-dependent examples.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mappings, limits, command semantics and GUI access are project readiness inputs. With those supplied, the manual GUI-centered case can proceed safely.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject its read-only/no-risk reduction because it removes most source coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its write/thermal/restoration controls; change capability to MANUAL ONLY because BMC Web UI comparison is an explicit acceptance requirement.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores semantic coverage and distinguishes automated support from the human GUI core.

review_improvement: Prevents a harmless RPM query from masquerading as a test that actually changes control/threshold state and checks a GUI plus SEL response.
independent_technical_reasoning: This row is not a simple RPM read. Its acceptance includes a human BMC Web UI view and potentially hazardous 0%/threshold operations. Since the UI comparison is explicitly required and cannot be replaced by CLI under the locked rule, MANUAL ONLY is the appropriate classification while automation handles telemetry and guarded writes.
